map_role: multi-canton escarpment with a long open-air upper lane, an independent lower return, and inhabited hollow service chambers
density_profile: Five discontinuous dense cantons and contrasting wide open flight volume; three partly excavated circular workshops and secondary spare seams below

route_grammar.primary: west-to-east uninterrupted high-sky racing line; east terminal vertical dive; westbound lower-air return
route_grammar.alternative: early western descent; eastbound lower lane beneath the upper interruption; shared right-side turn and return
route_grammar.branch_rejoin: two physically different eastbound lines share an unobstructed east turnaround; an upper-line solid closure retains lower-line return
route_grammar.recovery: large free-flight clearance above the uneven settlement roofs; retrace locally after wrong district entry

interesting_relationships: Cranes rise from a single rooted rock shelf rather than hanging between floating islands
An upper sky race overlooks clustered, independently enterable service districts
Competing lanes rejoin at the eastern terminal without crossing unsupported bridge decks
authoring_affordances: Large central sky for manual event staging
Unfurnished east-middle saddles for a new factory or ground settlement
Two buried excavation seams accessible from the open world
Three round cavities suitable for room/interior furnishing
Space above the return line for future modular hoops or event gates

setpiece_candidates.name: Canton muster departure
setpiece_candidates.note: West start and early return clearances remain open; no event is scripted

setpiece_candidates.name: Central flight interruption
setpiece_candidates.note: A real-material obstruction test proves an independent low-lane return

setpiece_candidates.name: Three-vault encounter
setpiece_candidates.note: Grounded rock chambers can be finished without replacing the map-wide flight contract

setpiece_candidates.name: Right-arm catcher
setpiece_candidates.note: Preserves high-to-low descent clearance for a future scripted chase

procedural_exemplar_value: Demonstrates a grounded multi-settlement floor profile with orthogonal free-flight lanes and selectively excavated rooms; useful for terrain-canton part placement, clustered rather than repeated infrastructure, and intentional unfilled sky/room-space control
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Rookfall's crater and fractured bridge, Morrow's cable-suspended islands, Aster's dual vessels, and Beaconfold's through-going excavated express, this uses five unequal grounded cantons below two mostly aerial routes. No annular centrepiece or sawtooth/ratchet industrial strip is copied.
qualification_note: Classification and setpiece suggestions are informational corpus metadata; not Setup-v2, a scripted event, or a native playtest receipt
